Hi Priya 

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together a targeted dedicated capacity quote:

What we discussed:
- Target workload: interactive assistant + short summaries (avg 45 tokens per response, ~120 tokens per API request including prompts).
- Expected monthly volume: ~75M to 120M API tokens (you mentioned optimistic and conservative ranges).
- Latency SLO: 95th < 350ms for 2K token generation (most requests are <200 tokens).
- Preferred model family: Llama-3-like (we can serve tuned open models or your customer model).

Open questions / please confirm:
1) Can you confirm expected peak concurrent requests / qps (ballpark)? You said peak was ~120 concurrent users with occasional spikes; any estimate of concurrent requests/sec helps sizing.
2) Do you have a target unit cost for budgeting (e.g., $/1M tokens) we should aim for when sizing reserved capacity? You mentioned a rough target of $250-350 / 1M tokens on the call is that still accurate?
3) Any constraints for GPU type (A100 vs H100) or preference for reserved vs burstable capacity?

Next steps from our side once we have answers:
- We will produce a short TCO quote for Dedicated with two configs (4x A100 80GB reserved and 4x H100 reserved) showing expected throughput, headroom, and estimated $/1M tokens.
- Proposal will include a canary plan (start with 2 GPUs for 2 weeks then ramp to full reserve) and suggested rollout/rollback thresholds.

Attached: placeholder for your usage sheet so we can align numbers (please update if helpful).

Thanks 
Dylan Brooks

Hi Priya 

Thanks for the details and the usage sheet. Marcus and I reviewed and put together two recommended configs below (high-level). We have attached a short pricing sheet and a sample canary plan.

Option A  4x NVIDIA A100 80GB (reserved monthly)
- Estimated sustained throughput: ~1.2M tokens/minute cluster (aggregate, depends on model).
- Headroom for bursts: supports short ~5-10min spikes up to ~1.8M tokens/minute before latency impact.
- Estimated effective unit cost at 100M tokens/month: ~$275 / 1M tokens (includes reserved capacity discount + typical batching gains).
- Recommended contract: 12-month reserved commit (monthly invoice) with 2-week canary at 50% capacity before full activation.

Option B  4x NVIDIA H100 (reserved monthly)
- Estimated sustained throughput: ~1.8M tokens/minute cluster (better perf on larger models).
- Headroom for bursts: supports spikes up to ~2.6M tokens/minute in short windows.
- Estimated effective unit cost at 100M tokens/month: ~$360 / 1M tokens (higher infra but better perf and lower latency risk).
- Recommended contract: 12-month reserved commit. If you commit to 12+ months we can offer an additional 8-12% discount on the H100 configuration.

Notes and next steps:
- If your CFO is pushing for $200 / 1M tokens we can explore a blended approach: start on 4x A100 with aggressive batching + KV caching and evaluate after 60 days if traffic growth justifies H100 we would propose a mid-contract upgrade with crediting for unused term. That gets unit cost closer to your target over time.
- We will include SOC2 summary and a short security appendix in the external quote.
- Marcus can you confirm the latency numbers for the specific model variant Priya mentioned and include estimated 95th percentiles per config?

Attached: Redwood_dedicated_pricing_v1.pdf, canary_rollout_plan.docx

Priya / procurement happy to schedule a 30-minute pricing walkthrough. If the numbers look reasonable we will follow up with a formal quote and contract terms (we will add procurement on the DocuSign route).
